Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Compound_structures, Molecule_dictionary. Join: Activities.molregno = Molecule_dictionary.molregno; Molecule_dictionary.molregno = Compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613918'); standard_value IS NOT NULL; standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
